description_expanded: ABOUT SHORE THING Welcome to Shore Thing - a stylish, sun-soaked newly constructed getaway located in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach, Florida, just minutes from the sugar-white sands of 30A. This spacious private home features 5 beautifully appointed bedrooms (including 4 king en-suites and 1 queen suite) and 5.5 bathrooms, comfortably sleeping up to 12 guests. Whether you're planning a family vacation, a couples' retreat, or a friends' getaway, Shore Thing has everything you need for a high-end, coastal escape. Inside, enjoy luxury finishes, Smart TVs, high-speed WiFi, and a full wet bar for evening cocktails. The open-concept kitchen is fully equipped for group meals, and the stylish living area includes a sleeper sofa for extra flexibility. Step outside to your private pool and soak up the Florida sunshine, or cruise around the area with 4 complimentary bikes. With pet-friendly accommodations, a garage, and 4 designated parking spots, Shore Thing is designed for comfort, convenience, and connection. ABOUT THE AREA Located in the desirable Beachside 30A area, Shore Thing puts you close to the best of Santa Rosa Beach. Stroll or bike to nearby beach accesses, explore local boutiques, or indulge in fresh Gulf seafood at top-rated restaurants. Whether you're paddle boarding at sunrise, lounging on the beach all day, or sipping cocktails at sunset, Shore Thing gives you the perfect home base to experience all that 30A has to offer. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS * 4 King En-Suites + 1 Queen Suite + Sleeper Sofa * Beachside Location Near 30A * Private Pool * Pet Friendly * Full Wet Bar * Fully Equipped Kitchen * Smart TVs & High-Speed WiFi * 4 Complimentary Bikes Included * 1-Bay Garage + 4 Designated Parking Spots * Luxury Coastal Finishes Throughout * Private Home PARKING * 1-bay garage + 4 designated driveway parking spaces PROPERTY RULES * Maximum occupancy: 12 guests (including sleeper sofa) * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hours of booking or reservation is subject to cancellation * Minimum age to book: 25 * Smoking is strictly prohibited * All reservations are non-refundable - we strongly recommend purchasing travel insurance * Pet-friendly with approval and applicable fee * Property manager not responsible for construction or noise outside the home ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first-class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our homes are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained to the highest standard. Our local team is available 24/7 to ensure your stay is seamless and stress-free. Our mission: to help you create lasting memories, one beach vacation at a time.
